description: PowerAtlas Asset-Level Power-Plant CO2 (measured + modelled): a multi-source dataset with owner, climate zone and derived intensities is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Dmytro Aheiev (Inzonex). An open, harmonised dataset of 4,551 power plants worldwide that each carry an asset-level annual CO2 figure with explicit provenance - regulator-measured for the US (EPA GHGRP, 616 plants) and the EU (EU ETS, 47 plants), and modelled/inferred from Climate TRACE (3,888 plants, satellite observation plus inventory inversion) elsewhere, i.e. Coverage: a single site or case study; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The repository holds 2 deposits of this kind (versions, parts or per-site or per-year releases); this record describes the series through its most recent member and lists the others in the notes. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
